_timezone_note: Morocco is on permanent GMT since 20 Sept 2026 (decree 2.26.530). Still: always use the tz database, never a fixed offset.

river_line._comment: Straight-line approximation of the Bouregreg, applied only inside bbox; north of the line = Salé bank.

default_windows._comment: Used only when a source gives a label but no hours. Shifts built from these are flagged *_assumed. The 24h window 09:00 -> 09:00 next day matches sahha.ma's explicit hours on 14 Nov 2026; cure.ma showed 12:00 next day for some entries. VERIFY during the data check.

normal_hours._comment: Owner's statement (15 Nov 2026): 10:00-20:00 Monday to Saturday. Public information says hours are set per prefecture (e.g. Casablanca 9:00-12:30 / 16:00-20:30, Saturday morning). Used only to show a soft hint and the 'all pharmacies' link; the roster answer is always shown.

selection._max_distance_comment: A garde pharmacy farther than this (straight line) is never proposed: better to say none is known nearby than to send someone to another city.

quartiers._comment: Centroids for the quartier picker when location is unavailable. Rough centres from the source pins seen on 14 Nov 2026; VERIFY with the owner.

_comment: National rules. cities: banks for the Rabat/Salé/Témara river rule only; the city list itself is data/cities.json. quartiers: picker entries for the Rabat area; other cities use their centroid.
